title: K562 causal gene network from Perturb-seq
subtitle: Faithful reconstruction of the inferred network from Brown et al. 2025
citation: Brown, B.C., Tokolyi, A., Morris, J.A., Lappalainen, T. & Knowles, D.A. Large-scale causal discovery using interventional data sheds light on gene network structure in K562 cells. Nature Communications 16, 9628 (2025).

generatedFrom.geneMetadata: Supplementary Data 2 from Nature Communications article supplementary XLSX

methodNotes: Edges are nonzero G_hat entries from the released essential-screen inspre graph table.
Node metrics come from Supplementary Data 2 gene-level information for the essential screen network.
Coordinates are deterministic viewer coordinates derived from eigencentrality and degree; they are not a published biological layout.
This is the paper's inferred causal network, not the true K562 regulatory DAG.
